summary: Enabled vars plugins run on demand by default. Since 2.10, RUN_VARS_PLUGINS (run_vars_plugins or ANSIBLE_RUN_VARS_PLUGINS) can be demand or start, meaning after each inventory source is imported. Plugins with a stage option can be set per plugin, for example [vars_host_group_vars] stage = inventory. ansible-inventory ignores these settings.
questions: Can I make group_vars load right after inventory is parsed instead of on demand?
Why does ansible-inventory behave differently with vars plugin timing?
How do I set the stage for the host_group_vars plugin?

answer_card.title: Controlling when vars plugins run
answer_card.answer_md:
Set `run_vars_plugins` under `[defaults]` (or `ANSIBLE_RUN_VARS_PLUGINS`):
- `demand` (default): run when tasks need variables
- `start`: run after each inventory source is imported

Per plugin, if it supports `stage`:

```ini
[vars_host_group_vars]
stage = inventory
```

`ansible-inventory` ignores these and always loads vars plugins.
